transcript.answer: `apps/floor` was deleted on 2026-10-02. It was replaced by the standalone external Floor engine (re-cinq/floor), which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`, as set out in ADR-049. The migration went one family of assembly lines at a time, with both floors running side by side until the last line had moved. Lore's own services took over the duties `apps/floor` still had. The stations service and lore-api now handle the cron ticks, repository events, sweeps, bus housekeeping, nightly consolidation and the run page's history reads. Some old pieces ended with it: the old walk, the single-agent task worker and watcher, and the dark-factory auto-merge evaluation. Later the same day, Lore's cluster agent and its `ai-agents` controller were also removed from the `lore-platform` chart. The floor installs its own controller. A memory episode links the move to PR #2431, but I could not confirm that PR number from the ADR.
sources: memory episode: session:re-cinq/lore (Floor component moved to an external engine, PR #2431)

judgements.reason: The answer gives the correct deletion date (2026-10-02) and replacement (the external re-cinq/floor per ADR-049), and it mentions PR #2431, though only tentatively and without the commit hash.
